title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter

suppliers.sup:70530: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. Our orders with you for part:350020 rose from EUR 400.19 (po:4500012924-10) to EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10) between 2025-09-15 and 2026-09-28. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:350020 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020), below your price. The forecast for part:350020 increased by 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

On volumes, we plan 4580 pcs per year over a 24-month agreement, which gives you planning security for your capacity. The attached packages include longer payment terms to support your cash planning. Could you also tell us whether a cheaper variant is available?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020 from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your historical purchase data and should-cost estimate, which we have factored into our revised calculation.

As to the price history and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. In exchange for the 36-month contract duration you proposed, we can offer a reduced price of EUR 427.96 per unit while maintaining the 30-day payment term.

Our offer stands at a price of €427.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding your technical inquiry, our engineering department will contact you to discuss potential alternative variants.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the 36-month term. We understand the constraints you described. Your sales director signalled in our review on 26 August (doc:20260826-70530-M1) that payment terms and call-off flexibility are open. We have therefore moved toward you on price in each attached package and use payment terms to close the gap.

All three packages cover 4580 pcs per year over 36 months. This volume secures your capacity, and the term holds the price stable for both sides. Which of these packages could you sign as your primary offer? Is there a cheaper variant, for example a different call-off pattern, that would help your planning?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – revised packages for part:350020
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We can accommodate a 45-day payment term; however, as our base prices are frozen, this adjustment results in a unit price of EUR 428.69. As an alternative, we offer a price of €428.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Our engineering department is currently evaluating potential alternative variants and call-off patterns to support your planning.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your revised offer and the 45-day alternative. We have moved toward you again in each attached package. All three cover 4580 pcs per year over 36 months, which secures your capacity planning for the full term. The payment variants let you choose the package that best fits your cash planning.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

If one of these packages works for you, could you make it your primary standing offer? We would also welcome the result of your engineering team's review of alternative variants and call-off patterns.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – part:350020, revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our offer stands at a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months.

As an alternative, we can offer a price of €428.69 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. As our base prices are frozen, we must maintain our offer of EUR 428.69 per unit for a 45-day payment term over a 36-month contract.

Please advise if you wish to proceed with these alternatives, as they require your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Application Engineering:
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 15.94 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 11.23 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 7.02 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

messages.subject: Frame agreement part:350020 - revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for confirming your packages. We have moved toward you again; the attached sheets are our revised proposal.

Both packages cover 4580 pcs per year, over 36 or 24 months. They keep the 90-day payment term you offered, so your standing structure is unchanged.

To ease your workload around the holiday shutdown, we will place January call-offs before your December cut-off each year, as in your note of 1 December 2025.

We do not need a new drawing revision or alternative variant for these packages. If one of them works for you, could you make it your primary standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Frame agreement part:350020 - revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We appreciate your offer to place January call-offs before our December cut-off, which supports our capacity planning. As our base prices are strictly frozen by our management, we cannot offer further price reductions for the 90-day payment term. We must therefore maintain our offer of EUR 430.88 per unit for a 36-month contract with 90-day payment terms.

Accordingly, our Angebot remains a price of €430.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Frame agreement renewal part 350020 – revised package
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your clear reply and for your note on the January call-offs.

We respect the price freeze you described. We have moved substantially toward your offer again in the attached package. It keeps your full structure: 90-day payment, 4580 pcs per year and a 36-month term. The 36-month term gives you stable volume and capacity planning through the whole period. We will also place January call-offs before your December cut-off each year.

Could you sign this package as your primary standing offer? If you cannot move further, please tell us whether your current offer is your final position.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. 

Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
